如果£scientist£科学官的等级足够的话，他们就能研究异常现象。

被发现但是尚未研究的异常现象会被列在情报日志的异常现象选项卡里。在殖民或是进行其它建设之前，£planet£行星上的异常现象必须先被研究。
texts.en:
We have found an Anomaly!

From time to time, our £science_ship£ Science Ships will make these discoveries while surveying alien worlds.

Anomalies can be researched by a £scientist£ Scientist, if their skills are up to the task!

Unresearched Anomalies are listed under the Anomalies tab in the Situation Log. Some must be investigated before the £planet£ Planet they were found on can be colonized or utilized.
